summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. filed a 6-K disclosing SMV notification that Inversiones Aspi S.A., a Holcim Ltd. subsidiary and joint obligor, submitted a November 11, 2026 brief curing SMV observations (Official Letter No. 5715-2026-SMV/11.1) on its previously announced public tender offer for the Company's common voting shares, alongside a simultaneous U.S. offer to U.S. resident shareholders and ADS holders. The filing attaches a revised PTO prospectus and a Muñiz legal opinion dated November 11, 2026; terms, price per share and premium remain unstated here. Watch SMV approval timing and tender acceptance dynamics for arbitrage implications.
